تصللن (form I)
# تَصْلِلْنَ (taṣlilna) /tasˤ.lil.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of صَلَّ (ṣalla)
# تُصْلَلْنَ (tuṣlalna) /tusˤ.lal.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of صَلَّ (ṣalla)
